title: UTA: Universal Training Adaptive Learning Rate Decay
abstract: arXiv:2610.35113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning rate decay (LRD) is critical for training high-performance models, yet most designs remain empirically driven. Although the Universal Budget Aware (UBA) LRD offers a theoretical framework, its reliance on SGD dynamics limits its applicability to modern Adam-type optimizers and leaves its key `optimization difficulty parameter' opaque. To bridge this gap, we propose the Universal Training Adaptive (UTA) LRD. Unlike UBA's fixed offline trajectory anchored solely to iterations, UTA treats LRD as a closed-loop shape-and-scale problem. By continuous-time formulation, UTA is training-state adaptive with segment-wise optimal shape. This adaptivity links external iterations with internal training states, enabling a near-optimal path in both progression shape and learning rate (LR) scale, a property unattainable by other LRDs, including UBA. translated_title: UTA：通用训练自适应学习率衰减
translated_abstract: 学习率衰减（LRD）对于训练高性能模型至关重要，然而大多数设计仍然依赖经验驱动。尽管通用预算感知（UBA）LRD提供了一个理论框架，但其对SGD动力学的依赖限制了它对现代Adam类优化器的适用性，并使其关键的“优化难度参数”不够透明。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了通用训练自适应（UTA）LRD。与UBA仅锚定于迭代次数的固定离线轨迹不同，UTA将LRD视为一个闭环的形状与尺度问题。通过连续时间公式化，UTA具有训练状态自适应性以及分段最优的形状。这种自适应性将外部迭代与内部训练状态联系起来，使得学习率衰减在推进形状和学习率（LR）尺度上都能实现近似最优的路径，这是包括UBA在内的其他LRD无法实现的特性。实证结果表明，我们在语言模型（LLaMA 60M到1B）上取得了一致的性能提升……
tldr: 提出UTA学习率衰减方法，通过连续时间闭环公式将外部迭代与内部训练状态自适应关联，在衰减形状与学习率尺度上均实现近似最优路径，克服了UBA依赖SGD动力学且参数不透明的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes UTA, a closed-loop continuous-time learning rate decay method that adaptively links external iterations with internal training states, achieving near-optimal decay paths in both shape and LR scale while overcoming UBA's reliance on SGD dynamics.
